name: z0
description: The z0 app. A workspace package so the app owns its own dev script; its services live in the sibling sub-packages.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,online,buzzer,remote,editor,presenter,monitor -c auto "npm run dev --workspace=z0-backend" "npm run dev --workspace=z0-online" "npm run dev --workspace=z0-buzzer" "npm run dev --workspace=z0-remote" "npm run dev --workspace=z0-editor" "npm run dev --workspace=z0-presenter" "npm run dev --workspace=z0-monitor"
